# iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority (Resource)

This resource can manage the configurable AP tag source priorities (`ap tag-source-priority <2-3> source <filter|ap>`), which decide whether AP filters or the AP itself (PnP) take precedence. Priorities 0 (static), 1 (location) and 4 (default) are fixed by the device and cannot be managed. The device rejects any single change that assigns one source to two priorities at once, so swapping the sources of priorities 2 and 3 is applied in two steps (the priority whose source changes is removed first, then both priorities are written). Destroying this resource restores the factory order (2 = `tag-source-filter`, 3 = `tag-source-ap-pnp`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority" "example" {
  priorities = [
    {
      priority = 2
      source   = "tag-source-ap-pnp"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `priorities` (Attributes List) Priority for tag source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--priorities))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--priorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `priorities`

Required:

- `priority` (Number) Priority for tag source
  - Range: `2`-`3`
- `source` (String) tag source
  - Choices: `tag-source-filter`, `tag-source-ap-pnp`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority.example ""
```
